title: Glade creation concentrates herbivory and slows tree recovery in encroached savannas
content:
Managing encroachment using higher-than-current fire intensity/frequency and/or large-scale tree clearing is limited to only well-resourced land managers. In contrast, active glade creation could become a widely applicable and affordable mechanism for land managers to create sustainable forage for grazing and browsing mesoherbivores that support species and functions that are otherwise lost in heavily encroached systems.

Abstract

Woody encroachment and thickening (i.e. the expansion of woody plants into grassy ecosystems) is compounding the rapid loss of grasslands and savannas globally. Clearing trees to manage encroachment is often ineffective if it does not restore the processes that limit woody plant recovery. We test whether artificial glades concentrate mesoherbivores and limit woody recovery via local feedbacks. In a South African savanna that has undergone substantial woody thickening, we cut 24 m × 24 m artificial glades into six sites encroached by broad-leaved (Combretaceae) or fine-leaved (Fabaceae) species and coupled them with paired uncut plots. At each plot, we set up two paired subplots and fenced (herbivore removal) one to test whether mesoherbivores would concentrate sufficiently to restrict tree resprouting and maintain open glades. We found that browsers and grazers select glades over woodlands when glades are cut into fine-leaved stands, but grazers show lower preference, and browsers do not select glades cut into broad-leaved stands. After a single growing season, intense browsing on fine- and broad-leaved resprouts kept them below 50 and 80 cm, respectively. Synthesis and applications. Managing encroachment using higher-than-current fire intensity/frequency and/or large-scale tree clearing is limited to only well-resourced land managers. In contrast, active glade creation could become a widely applicable and affordable mechanism for land managers to create sustainable forage for grazing and browsing mesoherbivores that support species and functions that are otherwise lost in heavily encroached systems.

Nkomiso

Ku nghenelela ni ku engeteleka ka mirhi (ku vula ku hangalaka ka swimila swa mirhi eka tindhawu ta byanyi) swi ya emahlweni swi hatlisisa ku lahleka ka tindhawu ta byanyi ni savanna emisaveni hinkwayo. Ku tsema mirhi ku lawula ku nghenelela a swi tirhi kahle loko ku nga vuyelerisiwi tindlela leti lawulaka ku tlhela ku kula ka yona. Eka ndzavisiso lowu, hi kambisisa loko tindhawu leti endliweke hi mavoko (glades) ti nga hlengeletaka swiharhi leswi dyaka swimila swa mpimo wa le xikarhi (mesoherbivores) ni ku hunguta ku tlhela ku kula ka mirhi. Eka savanna ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga ni ku engeteleka lokukulu ka mirhi, hi endle tindhawu ta 24 m × 24 m (glades) eka tindhawu ta tsevu leti nga ni mirhi eyi nga ni matluka lamakulu (Combretaceae) kumbe lamantsongo (Fabaceae). Tindhawu leti ti fananisiwile ni leti nga tsemiwangiki. Eka ndhawu yin'wana ni yin'wana, hi veke swiphemu swimbirhi leswi fanaka, kutani hi sirhelele xin'we ku sivela swiharhi, leswaku hi ta kota ku vona loko swiharhi swi nga hlengeletana hi ndlela leyi swi nga sivela ku tlhela ku mila ka mirhi ni ku hlayisa tindhawu leti pfulekeke. Hi kumile leswaku swiharhi leswi dyaka byanyi (grazers) ni leswi dyaka matluka (browsers) swi rhandza tindhawu leti pfulekeke ku tlula tihlahla loko ti endliwile eka mirhi leyi nga ni matluka lamantsongo. Kambe tigrazers a ti swi hlawuli ngopfu, naswona tibrowsers a ti swi hlawuli tindhawu leti endliweke eka mirhi leyi nga ni matluka lamakulu. Endzhaku ka nguva yin'we ya ku kula, ku dyiwa swinene ka swimila leswi tlhela swi mila swiva ehansi ka 50 cm (eka lamantsongo) ni 80 cm (eka lamakulu). Nkatsakanyo ni matirhiselo: Ku lawula ku nghenelela ka mirhi hi ndzilo lowu nga ni matimba lamakulu kumbe ku tsema mirhi hi mpimo lowukulu swi lava switirhisiwa swo tala naswona swi koteka ntsena eka vafambisi lava nga nwankumi. Kambe ku tumbuluxa tindhawu leti pfulekeke hi mavoko swi nga va ndlela leyi oloveke ni leyi nga durhiki ngopfu, leyi nga pfunaka vafambisi va misava ku tumbuluxa swakudya leswi nga tshamaka nkarhi wo leha swa swiharhi leswi dyaka byanyi ni matluka, leswi seketelaka tinxaka ni mintirho ya swona leyi nga lahleka eka tindhawu leti nga ni mirhi yo tala.
